signals.thesis: Following the market sell-off over Meta Platforms' negative free cash flow, record-high credit-default swaps, and plans for a new non-voting share class, Meta announced plans to raise $95 billion via a stock offering to fund AI infrastructure and superintelligence. Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom are eyeing up to $5 billion in the shares, highlighting how chip suppliers are increasingly helping finance hyperscaler capital needs.
signals.title: Meta announces $95B stock offering for AI as Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom eye $5B in shares

signals.thesis: Following trader preparations for a rout after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's 51.8% to 48.2% runoff victory over investor-favored Flávio Bolsonaro, Brazil's main stock index sank to a two-month low alongside a plunge in the nation's currency, debt, and Brazil-linked equities like PagSeguro. The currency drop dragged down most emerging-market currencies and triggered a slump in soybean and coffee prices by boosting export prospects for the agricultural giant.
signals.title: Brazilian assets, emerging currencies, and crop prices plunge after Lula's runoff win

signals.thesis: Anthropic filed its S-1 paperwork to go public next month while a coalition of banks and Blackstone lined up a record $63 billion financing vehicle—sealed after intervention by Broadcom's CEO—to buy AI computing infrastructure from Broadcom and lease it to Anthropic. Although the filing warned Anthropic may need additional financing sooner than anticipated and said little on a path to an investment-grade credit rating, the move stemmed AI bubble anxiety and drove a rally in U.S. tech and Asian semiconductor stocks.
signals.title: Anthropic files for IPO and seals $63B Broadcom-backed financing deal, sparking global tech rally

signals.thesis: China's five-year government bond yield dropped to an all-time low after the People's Bank of China increased its cash injection into the banking system. The central bank liquidity boost comes as Chinese equities remain mired in a bear market and heavily indebted local governments cut back.
signals.title: China 5-year bond yield hits record low after PBOC steps up cash injection

signals.thesis: Following recent Houthi strikes on Saudi infrastructure and U.S. diplomatic evacuations that had pushed crude to five-month highs, oil prices fell as Saudi Arabia's defense minister traveled to Iran for talks to de-escalate the conflict. Traders weighed the diplomatic outreach and concerns that elevated prices could erode demand against the ongoing threat of further attacks on Saudi energy sites.
signals.title: Oil prices fall as Saudi defense minister travels to Iran for de-escalation talks
